name: Digital Fox Client Launchpad
description: End-to-end Digital Fox performance-marketing client onboarding pipeline: from intake and Discovery through site build, integrations, deployment, ad launch, and monthly reporting. Self-orchestrating: the platform delegates whole operations and the module runs its internal pipeline (see source/template/.claude/skills/ORDER.md).

operations.name: Onboard Client (Phase 1)
operations.description: Full Digital Fox client onboarding from intake through live Cloudflare Pages deployment. The module runs its internal pipeline (init → pre-research → brief → research → semantics → strategy → strategy-pdf → offer → architecture → design → site → integrations → seo → deploy) end-to-end, asking the user for confirmation on dangerous actions and pausing on human-only steps (Discovery brief, offer approval).

operations.name: Launch Ads (Phase 2)
operations.description: Phase 2 ads kickoff once the site is live. Human-led step (GUI dashboard work); the module guides and the user executes.

inputs.name: clientPath
inputs.description: Absolute path to the client folder created by onboard-client.

operations.name: Monthly Report (Phase 2)
operations.description: Recurring optimisation pass and monthly client report.
